findings.produced: pub fn notification_for; pub fn approval_for
findings.consumer_location: none found externally (only intra-module use inside run() and tests)
findings.rationale: Both helpers are the policy-decision primitives of the R5 router. They are pub so future shells (mobile, voice) can call them directly without going through `run()`. Today only `run()` calls them. Borderline because keeping them pub is cheap and the doc comments are architecture source-of-truth.
findings.proposed_change: Leave as-is; revisit when a second surface is wired. Alternative: drop `pub` (becomes crate-private test helpers).
findings.verification: rg -n "notification_for|approval_for" src/ interfaces/ shared/ → only inside src/gateway/surface/r5_router.rs.
